text: {"score":3,"justification":"Most numbers match the card: 9.8% vs 2.2%, 1,838 claims, risk-adjusted score 10.65, z 0.97, 65% low-complexity, 30 documented claims, 1 of 6 below billed, and 2 of 16 with no lab on the claim.
